title: Mallworld entities
content: This is an AI rendering of one of the entities I frequently would be chased by in mallworld. I call him the “old man with the tubes coming out of his head” He would be pushed by this “goth man” and they would chase me down the hallways, through the bathroom, and on separate occasions through the forest. Every single time he would catch up to me and the old man in the wheelchair would paralyze me with his eyes and I would feel like a heavy vibration, then I would jolt awake. I dreamt of him for years. I mostly experienced these dreams around age 8-10. I would wake up having night terrors. Finally the dreams stopped for a while. Then I met this girl at age 16 in the waking world and we instantly hit it off. She told me of her psychic experiences and her dreams right off the bat, never having brought up the subject myself. We hung out a lot for about a week and eventually she went home back to the United States. I never discussed this particular recurring dream with her. Eventually a few months later she hit me up on Snapchat and told me she woke up with sleep paralysis and saw a “little old man in a wheelchair with black eyes” in the corner of her room. She kept being bombarded with flashes of me and heard my name in her head. Ever since then I never had a dream about this man. But it still freaks me out super bad to this day.
